name: stream-flutter
description: Build, integrate, review, migrate to, and answer how-to questions for Stream Chat, Video, and Feeds in Flutter / Dart apps. Supports stream_chat_flutter (pre-built Chat UI), stream_chat_flutter_core (custom Chat UI), stream_video_flutter (calls, ringing, audio rooms, livestreaming), and stream_feeds (Activity Feeds v3, no pre-built UI). Routes each request to the exact official Flutter docs page, fetches it live, and applies it - with a curated setup flow, a push / ringing runbook, design-matching and custom-UI runbooks, a Sendbird -> Stream Chat migration runbook, a read-only integration review before going live (including livestream launches), an AI integration runbook (ChatGPT-style apps, LLM bots in chat, streaming responses, thinking indicators, reasoning and tool-call steps, tool approvals, device-side tools, generative UI with A2UI, voice agents and their transcripts, apps built on Stream Agents, with stream_chat_flutter_ai), and Flutter-specific pitfalls.
